answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after completing randomly assigned, multi-party tasks that require consistent contributions over time; peers attest to the work, and a bond is slashed if later audits reveal collusion or fabricated results. A sybil operator must therefore fund many accounts, keep them active, and risk losing each bond, rather than minting identities cheaply. A violet comet could trigger a ripple of new accounts, but it cannot instantly buy trusted history.
